High Court Of Jammu & Kashmir And Ladakh
 At Jammu
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The petitioner has challenged the complaint filed by the respondents against him, alleging commission of offences under Sections 26[2(i) & (ii] read with Section 59 (i) and 52 of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 as also order dated 18.05.2016, by virtue of which, the Chief Judicial Magistrate, Udhampur has issued process against the petitioner.

It is contended by the learned counsel for the petitioner that the petitioner is not the Proprietor of firm-M/s Dogra Traders and he has been wrongly impleaded as an accused in the impugned complaint.

It has been further submitted that cognizance of the offences has been taken by the learned Magistrate against the petitioner beyond the prescribed period of limitation and that the impugned order dated 18.05.2016, whereby the process has been issued against the petitioner is cryptic in nature as the same does not disclose as to what offence has been prima facie made out against the petitioner.
Issue notice to the respondents, subject to petitioner's taking necessary steps within a week's time.
